top.description: Fabregas: ‘Nico Paz a wonderful cocktail, Como players want Man City and Juventus’ Cesc Fabregas hailed Nico Paz as ‘a wonderful cocktail’ of a football player, as the coach admits young players ‘don’t see Como as the apex of their careers, they want Manchester City or Juventus.’ The 22-year-old was a product of the Real Madrid youth academy and has flourished during his co-ownership deal with Como. That saw the Serie A club pay €60m to buy the other 50 per cent over the summer, giving Real Madrid an option to purchase him in June 2027 for €80m. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) “Nico is physique and talent, vision and mentality,” said Fabregas in a press conference today. “He is a wonderful cocktail, his Mum and Dad did a great job. I used to play in his position, so I like talking to him, find out if he sees the same things I do. At times, I think players don’t even need to be coached on movement or control, it’s more about tactics. “The great thing about Nico Paz is he doesn’t think about it, he just does the right things.” There have been strong reports of a potential bidding war for Nico Paz in the summer, including Arsenal, Manchester United and more. The Fulham captain has grown into a central figure at Craven Cottage, both in leadership terms and through his performances, and there is now a clear sense that his contract situation is becoming one of the more intriguing Premier League sub-plots ahead of the next transfer window. According to the report, Fulham are trying to tie Bassey down to fresh terms and are ready to improve his current salary significantly. However, the issue is straightforward enough. top.title: Fan Gets Physical with Dončić After He Throws Wristband
top.description: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images Luka Dončić admitted he threw his wristband at a fan before getting shoved, a move that may have started a fight. The Lakers star lost his temper after his team blew a 20-point lead to lose 99-96 on Friday night. Blaming the fan for the push ignores the fact that Dončić tossed the item at a person first. That action was the spark, and the player needs to take full responsibility for it. The video from Amazon Prime Video shows the exact moment the trouble began. Dončić tossed his white wristband toward a woman sitting in the first row as he walked toward the tunnel. Reports note that the woman appeared to say something to him before he threw the gear. He then doubled back to grab the wristband, which led to the physical contact. Dončić explained the sequence in his own words after the game. “I just threw my wristband like I do almost every game, and then I heard she or he didn’t want it,” Dončić explained postgame, according to a report. He went on to describe the push that followed his attempt to retrieve the item. “So I went back to grab it, and he just pushed me, and then I gave it to somebody else.” While no one should touch a player, the NBA star created the volatile situation by treating a paying customer like trash. Throwing equipment at fans is never acceptable, regardless of the score. Luka Doncic involved in an incident walking off the court following game at Spurs: pic.twitter.com/920AalPX6O — Underdog NBA (@UnderdogNBA) November 28, 2026 The Collapse That Sparked the Temper The incident happened right after the San Antonio Spurs completed a stunning comeback to win the game. The Lakers held a 20-point lead before the third quarter, but the Spurs outscored them 30-14 in that period. The final score of 99-96 ended the Lakers’ run in the NBA Cup group play. This loss officially eliminated the team from the tournament, leaving them with a 2-2 record. Dončić finished the night with 31 points on 14-of-31 shooting, along with 8 assists and 6 rebounds. His frustration was clear, but his reaction to the fans was the real story. Security Steps In Immediately Lakers forward Jarred Vanderbilt pulled Dončić away from the fan after the shove occurred. Team and arena security moved in right away to separate the parties and calm the scene. The male fan who pushed Dončić was ejected from Frost Bank Center for his actions. Two-way big man Carson Cooper helped hold Vanderbilt back as the situation de-escalated. It remains unclear if the NBA will fine or suspend Dončić for his part in the exchange. The league will review the footage to decide on any punishment for the player. Throwing a wristband at a spectator may be a lapse in judgment that a star player cannot make. Dončić said he heard someone did not want the item, yet he chose to toss it at them anyway. That decision turned a routine postgame walk into a safety incident. top.title: Shannon Sharpe says one aspect of Joel Embiid’s game has become ‘awful’ now
top.description: Photo by Andy Lyons/Getty Images The Philadelphia 76ers may be one of the most in-form teams in the NBA right now, but Shannon Sharpe still isn’t overly happy with one area of Joel Embiid’s game. The 76ers most recently took to the court on Friday night, securing a 111-87 win over the Indiana Pacers to go 16-4 for the season. That result means they have a very comfortable lead at the top of the Eastern Conference, with no other side managing more than 12 wins at present. During that victory, Embiid scored 14 points, had 11 rebounds and three assists. But Sharpe is not happy with how the player is performing from three-point range. Shannon Sharpe calls out Joel Embiid’s three-point shooting Speaking on the Nightcap podcast after the 76ers beat the Pacers, he said: “The thing is, they have to keep Embiid, he’s a shell of himself Ocho. “He’s still a guy that can get you, like you said, 20 points. He can get you 10, 11 rebounds. But for whatever reason, he’s struggling from the field. “I mean, he’s just awful from three. He hit one tonight, but I think he’s shooting under 20% from three.” Embiid went 1-3 from three-point range on Friday and when looking at his overall record this season, it is hard to argue with Sharpe’s claim. Since first stepping into the NBA in the 2016/17 season, the Sixers star has a 33.4% three-point field goal average. Up until the current campaign, his worst return on that front came in 2024/25, which he ended with a 29.9% average. But in 15 appearances so far this season, he is managing around half of that total (15.6%). Embiid has already addressed his three-point shooting decline earlier this month, saying: “I think the way I’m jumping, and my hands [placement] are just not what it used to be. top.description: Great Britain had not reached the final of the Davis Cup since they won the tournament in 2015 [Getty Images] Great Britain were unable to give Leon Smith the perfect send-off as Davis Cup captain as Carlos Alcaraz inspired Spain to a 2-0 victory in the semi-finals. Competing in their first Davis Cup semi-final since 2019, Britain fell short as Arthur Fery was unable to match the dazzling brilliance of Alcaraz, with the seven-time major winner surging to an emphatic 6-2 6-1 win. That was after rising star Rafael Jodar defeated Cameron Norrie 6-2 7-5 in the opening singles match to put Spain in the driving seat in Bologna. top.description: Bronson Reed and his wife, Paige Haley - Bronson Reed / Instagram The WWE has lost a tremendous talent. Bronson Reed , whose real name was Jermaine Haley, died on November 27, 2026, at the age of 38 due to “medical complications.” At the WWE Crown Jewel event just weeks before his death, Reed had suffered several broken ribs and a lacerated kidney. Following the shocking news, fans all across the world are mourning Reed’s death. When he wasn’t in the ring, Reed was a dedicated family man. He was married to Paige Haley, who is pregnant with their second child. Learn more about Reed’s life and family. How did Bronson Reed and Paige Haley meet? Reed and Haley were high school sweethearts in Australia and had been together a total of 24 years. At the time of Reed’s death, they were married. Back in 2020, Reed shared a throwback photo of his high school days with Haley. “She’s done more for me than she’ll ever know and everyone that meets her knows just how special she is. Despite growing up in Australia, the couple’s home base was in the United States. “America is the land of opportunity. You see we guys come from overseas and come to places like WWE. That’s what America is all about,” Reed told TV Insider in 2024. How many kids do Bronson Reed and Paige Haley have? Reed and Haley’s daughter, Deja, was born in February 2024. Reed had been open about their difficulties in conceiving and how they’d undergone IVF. For Haley’s first Mother’s Day, Reed penned a beautiful note to her. “I watched this woman go to the ends of the earth to have our daughter Deja,” he wrote on Instagram . “She is truly the strongest person I know, and in this short time, she has already become an incredible mother. Earlier this year, Reed gushed over how excited he was to return home to his wife and daughter. “Finally heading home after a tour, is the best feeling. top.title: Texas vs Texas A&M report card: Defense aces, but Arch Manning and offense get low grades
top.description: Texas Longhorns defensive back Jelani McDonald (4) celebrates an interception in the third quarter of the Lone Star Showdown game between Texas and Texas A&M at Kyle Field in College Station, Nov. 27, 2026. (Sara Diggins/Austin American-Statesman) COLLEGE STATION - It wasn't easy, but Texas football claimed a berth in the SEC championship game for the second time since entering the conference in 2024 with a 16-6 wi n over Texas A&M Friday at Kyle Field. The lowest-scoring game of the season for Texas reflected the downright ugliness of the hard-fought win . The Longhorns only scored one touchdown on three trips into the end zone, and they amassed a season-low 242 yards. OBSERVATIONS : Run game suffers, but run defense shines - again Texas Longhorns defensive back Samari Matthews (11) celebrates after beating the Texas A&M Aggies 16-6 in the Lone Star Showdown game between Texas and Texas A&M at Kyle Field in College Station, Nov. 27, 2026. (Sara Diggins/Austin American-Statesman) But No. 3 Texas (10-2, 7-2 SEC) won its sixth straight game and appears poised for a first-round bye in the College Football Playoff regardless of what happens next Saturday in the SEC title game in Atlanta. Here's how the Longhorns graded out in a 16-6 win over Texas A&M. Quarterback: C- Arch Manning didn't get much help from his receivers, but he still suffered through a mediocre game that included just 143 yards on 18-of-34 passing. He also threw a costly interception in the fourth quarter that would have helped Texas avoid some late-game drama. He'll have to play better against Georgia in the SEC title game. Season average: B- Running backs: D+ Michael Terry III (12 carries, 50 yards) ran hard and helped seal the win with some big runs late in the game. But the backfield continues to stumble with just a combined 75 yards on 22 carries from the backs. Starter Raleek Brown has just 35 yards on 14 carries over the past two games. Season average: C- Wide receivers: C- The good news? The one thing the Red Sox have to be mindful of is not overspending on a starter, which is why taking a chance on a guy with above-average stuff who might not be what he once was could be a wise decision. Something similar to what the Red Sox did with Sonny Gray could make a lot of sense. Last offseason, the idea behind landing Gray was to add a veteran arm with a strong track record at a reasonable price. The Pittsburgh Steelers lost to the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 11, and a few days later, after Aaron Rodgers went on The Pat McAfee Show to stir the pot with Mike McCarthy in particular, the Steelers waived the veteran quarterback. Rodgers hit waivers, but he went unclaimed. Now, he's a free agent and can sign with any team he wants this season. But there's one issue Rodgers now has to deal with: finding a team interested in his services. According to The Ringers' Tom Pelissero , there aren't any teams showing interest in Rodgers right now. If that doesn't change, with this 2026 season being Rodgers' last, his release by the Steelers could be what ends his Hall of Fame NFL career. Aaron Rodgers at risk of finding no new team after release from Steelers "No immediate suitors emerged for Aaron Rodgers after he cleared waivers Thursday," Pelissero reports. "And barring an injury-driven emergency, league sources don't foresee the four-time NFL MVP playing again in what Rodgers has repeatedly said is his final season." Coming into the 2026 NFL season, Rodgers made it known this would be his last year in the NFL. But after just 11 weeks, his season has been cut short, and not due to injury. He was waived by the Steelers following his public bashing of the Steelers' head coach, accusing him of sleeping during meetings and revealing the embarrassing "1, 2, 3, Packers !" breakdown from McCarthy at halftime vs. the Eagles. It would have to be an injury to a quarterback on a contending team that has no other option but to turn to Rodgers. It might also take the backup struggling in a major way. A situation akin to what the Minnesota Vikings experienced, with Kyler Murray hurt and Carson Wentz playing horribly, led to a trade for Kirk Cousins. That's the kind of situation that might lead to the ex-Steelers QB finding a new landing spot this season. top.title: On this day in space! Nov. 28, 1967: Astronomers Jocelyn Bell and Antony Hewish disover the 1st pulsar with Little Green Men 1 signal
top.description: null On November 28, 1967, astronomers found the first pulsar. A pulsar is a super-dense star that rotates super fast. As the pulsar spins, it emits two beams of light in opposite directions. When astronomers look at a pulsar, it looks like a star that's flickering on and off at a steady, constant pace. The first pulsar was observed by Jocelyn Bell Burnell and Antony Hewish. They were looking at the constellation Vulpecula when they saw a star flickering with regular pulses separated by 1.33 seconds. At first they had no idea what it was, so they jokingly nicknamed the signal Little Green Men 1. After more pulsars were discovered, they were able to rule out aliens. This chart tracked the signal of the first pulsar ever discoverered on Nov. 28, 1967. (Image credit: Cambridge University Library/Wikipedia) Why it mattered Pulsars are naturally occurring phenomena, and they can be handy tools for astronomers . For example, some pulsars are extremely accurate clocks. Because pulsars rotate, their emission of beams of radiation is observed at regular intervals. Until Burnell's discovery, astronomers did not know if neutron stars existed, let alone if they could be observed. "Suddenly, it turned out that nature has provided an incredibly precise way to observe these objects, something that has led to many later advances," said Edward Witten, chairman of the selection committee for the Fundamental Physics Breakthrough Prize, which in 2018 was awarded to Burnell . Among other applications, the observation of pulsars are one of the best ways astronomers have for testing Albert Einstein's theory of general relativity. The spinning stars have also been used as a navigation tool for spacecraft moving out beyond low Earth orbit. Want more space history? nigeria.title: Low turnout mars INEC mock accreditation exercise in Katsina
nigeria.description: By Fauziyya Lawal, Katsina Low voter turnout and inadequate public awareness characterised the mock accreditation exercise conducted by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) in Katsina State on Saturday ahead of the 2027 general elections. Vanguard monitoring of the exercise at Star Election Polling Unit, Wakilin Kudu 1, Kofar Gidan Iro Isansi, Rafin Dadi, showed that only a few voters turned out to participate, although some were successfully accredited. The low participation raised concerns about the level of public sensitisation and awareness among eligible voters regarding the importance of the exercise. The mock accreditation exercise is designed to test the functionality of the accreditation system, assess the preparedness of electoral officials and identify possible technical and operational challenges ahead of the actual elections. At the polling unit, the participation of the few voters provided an opportunity to observe the practical application of the accreditation process and assess the readiness of electoral personnel. The development also highlighted the need for increased public enlightenment to ensure that eligible voters understand the purpose and significance of such exercises. Adequate sensitisation is considered essential to encouraging participation in mock exercises, which enable electoral authorities to test arrangements and address possible challenges before the main elections. The exercise also provides an opportunity to identify operational gaps and resolve potential difficulties that could affect the smooth conduct of the 2027 general elections. nigeria.title: 2027: Low turnout mars INEC mock accreditation in Lagos

Polling agents expressed concern over the poor participation when Vanguard visited some of the designated polling units in Ijegun, Satellite Town and Festac, in the Amuwo-Odofin area of the state. An INEC polling agent at one of the polling units said only about 40 of the 250 registered voters had participated in the exercise as of the time of the visit. “The turnout has not been encouraging here. So far, about 40 people had voted out of 250 registered voters, and the BVAS has been cooperating smoothly due to good network. So we are certain of uploading the results after the exercise,” the agent said. A chieftain of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in Festac, Mr Olusegun Samuel, attributed the low turnout to inadequate awareness among residents. He alleged that many eligible voters were unaware that the mock accreditation exercise was taking place. “Apart from the ruling APC, many people are not even aware that mock accreditation took place today. “INEC is encouraging voter apathy by not engaging in active publicity. By this, the ruling party would still have its way come the 2027 general elections,” he said. However, a chieftain of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Saheed Bakare, described the exercise as encouraging, despite the challenges and low turnout. He said INEC officials arrived at the polling unit around 9 a.m. and met some voters waiting to participate. “So far, so good. The exercise is not perfect but encouraging. Bakare described the exercise as an opportunity to assess his party’s level of preparedness ahead of the 2027 general elections. nigeria.title: Dangote Refinery set to list on NGX December 1
nigeria.description: By Peter Egwuatu Dangote Petroleum Refinery & Petrochemicals FZE is scheduled to list 125,458,915,901 ordinary shares at N525 per share on the Main Board of Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX) on Tuesday, 1 December 2026. The listing is expected to add approximately N65.87 trillion to the market capitalisation of NGX. The listing follows the company’s Initial Public Offering (IPO), which attracted approximately 3.8 million subscribers from 121 countries, including all 54 African countries, reflecting unprecedented investor participation in a Nigerian public equity offering. With a minimum subscription of N5,250 for 10 ordinary shares, the offer enabled investors across income groups and geographical locations to participate in the ownership of one of Africa’s largest industrial enterprises. Speaking at the launch of the IPO in September, Aliko Dangote, President and Chief Executive of Dangote Industries Limited, described the offer as an opportunity to broaden public ownership and enable more Nigerians and Africans to participate in industrial wealth creation. “The Dangote refinery IPO is more than an investment opportunity; it is an opportunity for millions of Nigerians and Africans to build lasting wealth through ownership of a world-class industrial asset,” Dangote said. Investor participation at this scale was facilitated by NGX Invest, the SEC-approved digital capital-raising platform launched by Nigerian Exchange Group Plc (NGX Group) in June 2024. By enabling a network of 186 distribution channels, including stockbrokers, banks, fintech platforms and WhatsApp, NGX Invest provided the rail that significantly broadened access to the public offer. Temi Popoola, Group Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of NGX Group, said: “The listing of Dangote Petroleum Refinery will mark an important milestone for Nigeria’s capital market, demonstrating its capacity to support large-scale industrial enterprises and mobilise long-term capital. The breadth of investor participation in the public offer also reflects the progress we have made in expanding market access. Through technology, strategic partnerships and a diverse distribution network, we are connecting more people to investment opportunities and more businesses to capital.” According to the company’s prospectus, net proceeds from the IPO will partly finance an estimated US$14.3 billion expansion programme designed to double refining capacity from 700,000 to approximately 1.4 million barrels per day. The transaction underscores the capital market’s strategic role in financing industrial expansion, broadening economic participation and supporting Nigeria’s ambition of becoming a US$1 trillion economy. Government officials, regulators, business leaders, market operators and representatives of African exchanges are expected to attend the listing ceremony. nigeria.title: INEC, security agencies addressing security concerns ahead of 2027 polls – Amupitan
nigeria.description: Chairman of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), Prof. Joash Amupitan, says the commission, in collaboration with security agencies, is taking necessary steps to address all security concerns ahead of the 2027 general elections. Amupitan ​‌‍‍‍‍⁠⁠‍⁠​⁠‌‌‍‍‌‌​stated this on Saturday in Jos while speaking with newsmen during the monitoring of the ongoing mock accreditation. Addressing a question on the security challenge and the likely implications on voter participation, Amupitan said the safety of ad hoc staff and all Nigerians remained a priority to the commission. “As the chairman of INEC, I’m also worried about the state of security in Nigeria, but you can see we are taking some good steps to ensure that we nip it in the bud. “Just two days ago, we had a national security conference where we brought together all the members of the Inter-Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security (ICCES), the police, the military, the Civil Defence, and other paramilitary agencies. “So, we had a one-day conference where we discussed all these issues,” he said. Amupitan said that INEC had conducted a risk assessment of every part of Nigeria, using Election Risk Management (ERM) tools. “We have identified all the polling units that are vulnerable, and we have shared this with the law enforcement agencies so that they can make extraordinary preparation for those places. “Any polling unit 500 meters from those vulnerable areas has been identified, and we are going to deal with it,” he said. Amupitan said the commission was interested in the security of the voters and ad hoc staff, particularly corps members. “It’s not every security matter you can bring to the open, but we are doing everything, both intelligence and physical, to ensure that the security on election day is assured,” he said. nigeria.title: Referee faces suspension after punching goalkeeper in post-match rawl
nigeria.description: A Bolivian referee, Jordy Aleman, might face be faced with strict suspension rules after punching Real Potosi goalkeeper Cristian Martinez during a post-match confrontation following the 2026 Copa Bolivia final. The incident occurred on Wednesday after Always Ready secured the trophy with a 3-1 aggregate victory over Real Potosi. The second leg ended in a goalless draw at the Victor Agustin Ugarte Stadium in Potosi. Tensions flared after the final whistle as Real Potosi players approached Aleman to protest decisions made during the match. Television footage showed the referee punching Martinez in the face, triggering further disorder before police intervened to protect the officials. Reports from Spanish-language media, including MARCA, said the confrontation followed an insult directed at Aleman by the goalkeeper. Martinez reportedly told the referee, “I hope your mother dies.” Martinez later said the punch left his mouth bleeding. However, in a defiant response reported by El Diario, he remarked: “He should hit harder.” The goalkeeper also questioned Aleman’s professionalism and called for an exemplary punishment. He subsequently announced that he would not pursue legal action or file a formal complaint over the incident. In a statement shared by Spanish publication 20 Minutos, Martinez said: “My intention is to consider this episode over and avoid allowing this situation to continue generating conflict.” Aleman could face disciplinary sanctions under the Bolivian Football Federation’s Disciplinary Code, which reportedly provides for fines of at least 20 national minimum monthly salaries and bans of between one and three years for physical assaults. The incident also led to four Real Potosi players and three members of the club’s coaching staff reportedly receiving red cards. According to Bolivian publication Vision 360, the federation’s refereeing authorities are expected to review the incident alongside the match reports. Aleman’s status as an international referee could also have further implications. The referee has yet to make a public statement on the incident. nigeria.title: Meet Nigerian’s Maria Wophill named World Athletics’ Woman of the Year
nigeria.description: Veteran Nigerian sports administrator Maria Wophill has been named the World Athletics (WA) 2026 Woman of the Year in recognition of her decades-long contribution to gender equality and the development of women and girls in athletics. World Athletics announced the honour as part of its 2026 awards, recognising Wophill’s efforts to create opportunities for women in track and field through leadership, advocacy and grassroots development. Wophill previously served as secretary-general of the Athletics Federation of Nigeria (AFN) between 2005 and 2013. She has also held senior positions in the Federal Ministry of Youth and Sports Development and served on the World Athletics Women’s Committee from 2010 to 2018. Her contributions to Nigerian sports administration include advocacy for increased female representation on the boards of national sports federations, which helped secure additional positions for women. At the continental level, she championed the establishment of the Confederation of African Athletics (CAA) Gender Leadership Task Force in 2024. She has also mentored female coaches and sports administrators through the Women’s Sport Leadership Academy (WISH), while supporting grassroots participation through the Abuja FCT Girls Sprints and Relays, an initiative aimed at encouraging secondary school girls to take part in athletics. Reacting to the recognition, Wophill expressed gratitude to World Athletics and Nigerian sports organisations, describing the award as a motivation to continue contributing to the sport. “This has been a truly humbling year and I am very proud to be acknowledged for the work I have done,” she said. She added that the recognition had strengthened her commitment to promoting gender leadership, safeguarding young athletes and mentoring people within athletics. “This award has energised me to keep giving my best in all positions in athletics, with particular focus on gender leadership, safeguarding young athletes and mentoring within the sport,” she said. World Athletics President Sebastian Coe described Wophill as a deserving recipient, praising her efforts to improve female representation and mentor others in the sport. Her recognition is part of the 2026 World Athletics Awards, with the World Athletes of the Year, Rising Stars and Moment of the Year scheduled to be announced on Sunday. nigeria.title: Why Tinubu should stay in office for 10 years – Akande
nigeria.description: By Ayobami Okerinde Former Osun State Governor, Bisi Akande, has called for President Bola Tinubu to remain in office for 10 years, saying the period would allow him to complete ongoing projects and deliver lasting reforms. Akande made the call during an interview on the Frankly Speaking with Icon podcast, published on Friday. “He should remain in office, if possible, for another 10 years; otherwise, we go back to the situation of ‘Ebinpawa’ because there has been a foundation for hunger,” Akande said. He cited the Olubadan’s comments on road projects across the South-West, including routes linking Ijebu-Ode, Abeokuta, Oyo and Ikire, as evidence of the administration’s ongoing work. Quoting the traditional ruler, Akande said: “If you are working like this, and this had not been done 50 years before you, what again do we still say you should do, and you have not done? “But so that you will be able to complete this good job that you started, Ibadan people and Oyo State people are supporting you to do another four years.” Akande also blamed successive military administrations for what he described as decades of neglect of agriculture, education and economic development, saying their policies contributed to the country’s present difficulties. “Forty years before he came, since 1966, when the military started ruling you, you have been laying the foundation for hunger. You have abandoned your farms. You have abandoned the job. You have refused to be educated. You have refused to be modernised,” he said. He expressed optimism that Tinubu’s policies would produce significant improvements in the coming years, particularly in electricity supply and modernisation. “So in another 10 years there will be electricity everywhere. There will be modernisation,” he said. “They liberalised electricity. If you have money today, you can create electricity in your home. You can create it in your city. You can create it around you,” he said. Comparing the policy with the restrictions under previous military administrations, Akande said individuals were previously prevented from generating electricity independently. “Unlike what the military did before, if you tried to create electricity, they would arrest you. They would make you a debtor. They wouldn’t let you do it. They said only the Federal Government could do it. Tinubu came and said everybody can do it,” he added. On his own public engagements, the former governor attributed his reduced movement around the country to age, contrasting his present situation with when he was younger. nigeria.title: PHOTOS: Low Turnout as INEC begins Mock Election
nigeria.description: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) commenced its mock elections in Borno State to test-run voting equipment and logistical readiness ahead of the 2027 general elections. However, the exercise recorded a low voter turnout in some polling units visited by our correspondent due to what many residents described as “a lack of awareness”. The exercise, designed to evaluate the deployment of election personnel and the functionality of the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) across all 27 local government areas of the state, also faced a slow start in some polling units. Across Jere and Maiduguri Metropolitan Councils security personnel, including police officers and the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) and Road Safety Officials, were present early at some polling units, INEC officials arrived late. At the Bulama Jidda polling unit in Gomari Airport, voting commenced at 8:44 a.m. after officials arrived, slightly behind schedule. However, poll workers and voters at the station confirmed that the BVAS machines functioned efficiently. “There is actually a low turnout, but the use of BVAS is smooth. At some point, we are using it offline, but will upload it when we reach areas with a robust network,” one polling unit officer stated. Interviews with residents across various areas revealed that public awareness of the exercise was generally poor, with many locals unaware that the mock election was taking place. At the Gwange III polling unit, turnout was similarly low. Some prospective voters said they encountered some technical hitches during accreditation, reporting that the BVAS failed to capture their fingerprints and facial features. Speaking on condition of anonymity, an Ad-hoc staff, noted that affected individuals were not issued ballot papers. Instead, their details were compiled for INEC to review and resolve prior to the general elections. At the Government House polling unit (Unit 001, Maisandari Ward), where voter turnout was notably impressive, the process ran without hitches. Abacha Anas, the Electoral Officer for Operations for INEC in the Maiduguri Metropolitan Council, described the exercise as smooth and successful.

nigeria.title: Gunmen kill 51-year-old man, two others in fresh Plateau attack
nigeria.description: By Golok Nanmwa, Jos Gunmen have killed three persons in a fresh attack on Nkiedowro community in Teegbe District of Bassa Local Government Area of Plateau State, throwing residents into mourning. The attack, which occurred on Friday night, claimed the lives of three Irigwe natives, bringing to 20 the number of Irigwe people reportedly killed within the week, according to the National Publicity Secretary of the Irigwe Youth Movement, Joseph Chudu Yonkpa. Yonkpa, who confirmed the killings in a statement made available to newsmen on Saturday, said the attackers launched two separate ambushes on the community. “Yesterday night, Fulani militias launched two separate ambushes at Nkiedowro, Teegbe District, killing three Irigwe natives,” he said. He identified the victims as Ngudo Kura, 51; Hosea Ishaya, 26; and Naomi Izeh, 22. “This makes it a total of 20 Irigwe people killed this week in an unprovoked manner,” Yonkpa added. He expressed condolences to the families of the victims and the entire Irigwe community, praying for the repose of the souls of the deceased. Our correspondent reports that the latest killings occurred barely two days after 17 persons were given a mass burial following an attack on the Tafi Gana community, also in Bassa Local Government Area. The development has heightened concerns over the security situation in the area, with residents reportedly apprehensive about possible further attacks. The Irigwe Youth Movement urged residents to remain vigilant and avoid movements that could expose them to danger. “We call on our people to intensify vigilance, avoid late-night and isolated movements, and report suspicious movements to the relevant authorities,” Yonkpa said. The group also appealed to security agencies to strengthen surveillance and take necessary measures to protect communities in the area. Efforts to get the reaction of security operatives were unsuccessful as of the time of filing this report. business.title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack Binance has fully lifted the withdrawal suspension it put in place after last month’s record $6.3 billion hack, saying its recovery work is complete and that withdrawals are open across nearly all networks. “Our withdrawal recovery work is completed and the withdrawal suspension from the security incident has been fully lifted,” the exchange said in an X post Thursday afternoon. A small number of networks remain paused for maintenance, which Binance called standard practice and said was unrelated to the hack. The update closes out a month of phased reopenings. Binance confirmed the breach on Oct. 29, saying its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop that gave the attacker access to a service container, which was then used to submit unauthorized withdrawals. The world’s largest crypto exchange stopped all customer withdrawals for two days after the theft, Reuters reported . When they first reopened, customers pulled a net $4.7 billion off the platform, Binance said on Nov. 2. Binance covered the losses Binance said on Nov. 12 that it had completed coverage of the affected assets with more than $6.34 billion of company funds. The money came from a partial draw on its Secure Asset Fund for Users, part of its futures insurance fund and its corporate treasury, and the exchange pledged to rebuild SAFU to about $1 billion. Coverage is not the same as recovery. Binance replaced the stolen tokens from its own books, while about $2.85 billion of the stolen funds have been frozen remotely by the companies that issue them. The rest remains in the hands of the attackers. U.S. authorities have blamed North Korean hackers for the theft, which North Korea denies. On Nov. 23, the Justice Department moved to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC that Circle froze, and said the U.S. has helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion since the attack. Launderers turn to THORChain and coinjoin The unfrozen funds are on the move. North Korean launderers have stepped up transfers through THORChain and a coinjoin service in recent days, blockchain researchers told Reuters , as part of an operation spanning tens of thousands of transactions across blockchains. Chainalysis and Elliptic estimate that more than $600 million of the stolen crypto has passed through THORChain, though Elliptic said that figure could count funds that went through more than once. TRM Labs estimates THORChain earned as much as $1 million in fees from the swaps. Separately, $342 million has moved through a coinjoin service mostly coordinated by a pseudonymous figure named Kruw, Elliptic said. A coinjoin combines coins from many users into a single transaction, so their origin is no longer visible on the blockchain. business.title: Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test Russian bank VTB began letting brokerage clients buy and sell bitcoin in its investing app on Friday, a day after the Bank of Russia approved the knowledge test every Russian crypto buyer now has to pass. Starting Nov. 27, clients of VTB’s brokerage can trade cryptocurrencies in the VTB My Investments app, the broker said . For now, the trades happen over the counter rather than on an exchange, and access is limited to qualified investors, the legal term for Russians who meet wealth or experience thresholds, who also pass the new test. “In our model, access to cryptocurrencies will require qualified investor status and passing special testing,” Andrei Yatskov, head of brokerage services at VTB, said . He said the test would appear in the app on Nov. 27 and work like the bank’s existing tests for other instruments. VTB handles the buying, storage and record-keeping itself on Russian infrastructure. To trade, clients need to open a separate digital account at VTB’s digital depository, where the crypto is held, on top of their regular brokerage account. The bank received its digital depository and crypto exchange licenses on Oct. 6. “At the start, we will focus on buying and selling cryptocurrencies, and then we will introduce additional services as regulation develops,” Yatskov said. Eight questions before the first trade The launch came quickly after the regulator moved. On Nov. 26, the Bank of Russia approved the first basic standards for brokers and crypto exchange offices, setting the rules for the test. Every investor has to take it, qualified or not, and it is free. Buyers must answer at least seven of eight questions correctly. The standard lays out eight topic blocks, from regulation, technical basics and information security to stablecoins, low-liquidity coins, address labeling and blocked transactions, and volatility, with one question drawn at random from each. Investors who fail can try once more the same day, with different questions. Brokers are barred from sharing the correct answers with clients or telling them which questions they missed. A passing result stays valid for one year from the test date or the latest trade, whichever comes later. The test was the missing piece for Russian banks. When retail buying became legal on Nov. 17 , T-Bank said it was waiting on a market standard for testing, and VTB said it was waiting on the remaining rules. Under the broker standard, the industry’s self-regulatory organization has three working days after publication to send brokers the answer options and correct answers. Ordinary investors still face tight limits once they pass. Non-qualified buyers can only purchase bitcoin, ether and Tether’s USDT, and no more than 300,000 rubles a year through a single intermediary. SPB Exchange sets Dec. 1 start Exchange trading is next. business.title: New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders A New York judge has ordered the founders of NovaTech, a cryptocurrency investment scheme that targeted Haitian communities, to pay more than $1.37 billion, closing out the state’s case against a couple who fled the country rather than answer it. Justice Anar Rathod Patel of the New York County Supreme Court signed the order on Nov. 24. It holds Cynthia and Eddy Petion and their companies NovaTech Ltd, NovaTech Advisors and NovaPay jointly liable for $1,367,023,585 in disgorgement and interest. New York Attorney General Letitia James announced the win on Wednesday. “Today’s historic judgment finally delivers some semblance of justice for the thousands of New Yorkers who were targeted by this merciless scam,” James said. “NovaTech cruelly targeted immigrant families through faith and community groups with the promise of a better life while robbing them of their life savings.” Where the $1.37 billion figure comes from The award matches what the attorney general’s office asked for in October . The figure starts with the cryptocurrency investors sent to NovaTech’s wallet at payment processor CoinPayments, which totaled about $1.16 billion from August 2019 through May 2023, according to an affirmation filed by the state. Prosecutors subtracted the roughly $26 million NovaTech actually moved to its trading platform, leaving $1.13 billion in principal. Nine percent annual interest from June 2023 through September 2025 added another $232.5 million. NovaTech’s traders lost about $18.2 million of the money they did trade, the filing said. Everything else paid out of the wallet, including so-called returns and recruitment bonuses, came from other investors’ deposits. Cynthia Petion was the only authorized user on the CoinPayments account, and the state says she approved at least $134.5 million in crypto withdrawals to wallets belonging to her and her husband. The judge also ordered the Petions’ earlier venture, AWS Mining, to pay about $1.46 million. Cynthia Petion owes a separate $4.69 million tied to her promotion of that scheme. A NovaTech scheme built on prayer groups AWS Mining sold crypto mining contracts and promised 15% to 20% monthly returns before it collapsed in 2019, according to the attorney general’s office. The Petions then launched NovaTech, falsely marketed it as a registered hedge fund broker and advertised trading profits of about 2% to 4% a week. Promoters recruited through prayer groups, WhatsApp chats and ads in Haitian Creole. More than 11,000 New Yorkers invested, alongside what the state called hundreds of thousands of investors worldwide. NovaTech collapsed in May 2023, and tens of thousands of investors couldn’t withdraw their crypto. The state sued in June 2024. The Petions never answered the complaint. entertainment.description: Young man with a hard hat holding a red for sale sign outside a building by Pavel Danilyuk for Pexels . My parents’ generation mostly bought land the way their parents did. Someone in the family knew someone in the village. An uncle walked the boundaries. The community remembered who owned what, and if anything went wrong, you had a face to go back to. However, my generation buys land on Instagram. I do not say that to mock anyone. I sell land for a living. When I started in real estate sales in 2023, two years after finishing a Mathematics degree at the University of Ibadan, I assumed buyers would care most about price and location. They do care. But what I hear most often is fear, dressed up as questions. Can I trust you? Is this land real? What happens if I miss a payment? After I pay, will someone come and ask me for more money? A prospective buyer once asked me, before anything else, whether community or family payments would follow after she paid for her plot. She was not asking about the land. She was asking whether the price I quoted was the real price. She had good reason to ask. Lagos State’s Property Protection Law of 2016 made it an offence to demand levies for construction on someone else’s property. Yet the same law still allows a land-owning family, with the family head’s authority, to collect a customary fee for possession, the payment many people know as a “foundation levy”. So the honest answer to her question is not a simple yes or no. It depends on the land, the family, and what has been written down. Most first-time buyers have never been told any of this. That is the gap I keep coming back to. Nobody taught us how to buy land. We learned how to save. Some of us learned how to invest in stocks, crypto or a side business. But land, the asset our parents spoke about with the most respect, has no manual. The people who used to stand in for the manual–the uncle, the community, the family lawyer everyone trusted–are often not part of how we buy anymore. So we improvise. A prospect once told me she had gone through my Instagram page carefully before she agreed to speak with me. She was checking whether I was consistent, whether my posts matched what I said on the phone, whether I had been around long enough to be real. I was flattered. Then I was worried. Because if a social media page has become part of a buyer’s due diligence, then a polished page has also become one of the easiest ways to deceive her. Instagram cannot tell you who owns a piece of land. Only a search at the land registry, done by your own lawyer, can begin to tell you that. entertainment.title: M.Inc PR Joins Industry Stakeholders to Explore Africa’s Credit Economy at ACE 2026
entertainment.description: A cross section of industry leaders and stakeholders during the fourth edition of Africa Credit Expo 2026 held on Friday, 13 November 2026, at the J. F. Ade Ajayi Main Auditorium, University of Lagos. What will it take to make credit more accessible to African businesses and individuals? At the fourth edition of Africa Credit Expo (ACE) 202 6, stakeholders across financial services, technology, policy, investment and entrepreneurship examined the role of reliable credit information, financial inclusion and collaboration in expanding access to capital. Powered by CreditRegistry and supported by Afreximbank , the Expo was held on Friday, 13 November 2026, at the J. F. Ade Ajayi Main Auditorium, University of Lagos. Themed “Reimagining Africa’s Credit Economy: Unlocking Capital, Trust and Opportunity,” the event provided a platform for conversations on the systems, innovations and partnerships shaping the future of credit across the continent. Building Trust and Expanding Access to Capital Discussions at the Expo explored the role of credible credit information in building trust between lenders and borrowers. Reliable data enables financial institutions to assess risk more effectively and make informed lending decisions, while individuals and businesses with established credit histories are better positioned to demonstrate their credit worthiness. The conversations also considered the financing constraints facing micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). Despite their contribution to employment and economic activity, many small businesses continue to encounter barriers to affordable financing. Improving access to relevant financial products and strengthening credit information systems remain important to addressing these gaps. Technology, Financial Inclusion and the Next Generation Digital innovation and data intelligence featured prominently in discussions about the future of credit. Alternative credit assessment approaches have the potential to broaden access for individuals and businesses with limited formal credit histories. However, the expansion of digital financial services must be accompanied by responsible lending practices, consumer protection and transparency. The Expo also placed attention on young people through student-focused sessions and discussions on financial literacy. These conversations connected access to credit with the need for individuals to understand financial management, borrowing and long-term wealth creation. entertainment.title: As Nigeria Rethinks Teacher Education, Tunji Olowolafe Makes a Case for Better-Prepared Educators
entertainment.description: What makes a good teacher? Beyond knowing a subject, a good teacher can understand students, inspire confidence, and help young people discover what they are capable of becoming. It was this broader responsibility of educators that Dr. Tunji Olowolafe explored while delivering the 2026 Convocation Lecture at the Sikiru Adetona College of Education, Science and Technology (SACOETEC), Omu-Ajose, Ogun State. Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, on the theme “The Dual-Mandate NCE-Degree Programme: Prospects, Challenges and the Future of Teacher Education in Nigeria,” he described the programme as an important opportunity to reposition teacher education. For decades, Colleges of Education depended on university affiliations to award Bachelor’s degrees, despite many possessing the academic capacity to run such programmes. The Federal Colleges of Education Act 2023 changed this, empowering eligible institutions to award degrees independently. Under the Dual-Mandate programme, students can complete three years of NCE training and proceed to another two years for a Bachelor’s degree in Education. Dr. Olowolafe explained that combining practical teaching skills with deeper academic knowledge would produce better-prepared educators. However, he cautioned that institutional autonomy must be supported by sustained funding, improved curricula and professional development. With Nigeria facing an estimated shortage of one million teachers, he also called for greater integration of vocational education, artificial intelligence and digital skills into learning. “AI can explain a quadratic equation at midnight, but it cannot offer the steady, empathetic guidance of a caring adult,” he said, emphasizing that artificial intelligence must complement, not replace, the human qualities of effective teaching. During the lecture, Dr. Olowolafe announced that the Tunji Olowolafe Foundation would establish a fully equipped, solar-powered Gbemisola Olowolafe Memorial ICT Centre (GOMTECH) with high-speed internet connectivity at SACOETEC. The Foundation is also committed to recognising academic excellence and outstanding teaching at the College. This includes recognising the College’s first-class degree graduates and NCE distinction holders, alongside the overall best NCE and degree graduates. Lecturers, selected based on student ratings, will also be honoured for their teaching contributions. The initiative builds on the Foundation’s existing investment in education, including Project Digi-Teach at Ekiti State University and GOMTECH in Are-Ekiti. For Dr. Olowolafe, the commitment to educators is also deeply personal. His mother was a teacher, his elder sister taught for years at Baptist Academy, Lagos, and his late wife, Gbemisola Olowolafe, was a lifelong educator. He recalled the influence of teachers who shaped his own experience, particularly Mr. Soewu of Methodist Boys’ High School , whose patience helped students understand difficult concepts without humiliation. Born on 7 March 1947 in Zaria, Kaduna State, and hailing from Akamnato, Ifite Nteje in Anambra State, Pete Edochie began his career in broadcasting long before becoming a household name on television and cinema screens. At age 20, in 1967, he joined the Eastern Nigeria Broadcasting Service (ENBS)—later the Anambra Broadcasting Service (ABS)—rising steadily through the ranks to serve as Director of Programmes and Deputy Managing Director. His commanding presence and deep, resonant voice earned him international recognition—including a dedicated delegation interview from the BBC—and cemented his place in Nigerian television history. Over a screen career spanning nearly four decades, Pete Edochie became synonymous with authority,traditional wisdom, and unforgettable Igbo proverbs. Whether playing stern monarchs, principled elders, or complex patriarchs, he delivered every line with unmistakable gravitas. His extensive filmography includes standout appearances in classics and modern hits alike, such as Things Fall Apart (1987), Igodo (1999), Egg of Life (2003), Oracle (2003), Billionaires Club (2003), End of Money (2005), Lionheart (2018)—where he starred as Chief Ernest Obiagu alongside Genevieve Nnaji—Unroyal (2020), and Foreigner’s God (2022). sports.description: Fabregas: ‘Nico Paz a wonderful cocktail, Como players want Man City and Juventus’ Cesc Fabregas hailed Nico Paz as ‘a wonderful cocktail’ of a football player, as the coach admits young players ‘don’t see Como as the apex of their careers, they want Manchester City or Juventus.’ The 22-year-old was a product of the Real Madrid youth academy and has flourished during his co-ownership deal with Como. That saw the Serie A club pay €60m to buy the other 50 per cent over the summer, giving Real Madrid an option to purchase him in June 2027 for €80m. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) “Nico is physique and talent, vision and mentality,” said Fabregas in a press conference today. “He is a wonderful cocktail, his Mum and Dad did a great job. I used to play in his position, so I like talking to him, find out if he sees the same things I do. At times, I think players don’t even need to be coached on movement or control, it’s more about tactics. “The great thing about Nico Paz is he doesn’t think about it, he just does the right things.” There have been strong reports of a potential bidding war for Nico Paz in the summer, including Arsenal, Manchester United and more. The Fulham captain has grown into a central figure at Craven Cottage, both in leadership terms and through his performances, and there is now a clear sense that his contract situation is becoming one of the more intriguing Premier League sub-plots ahead of the next transfer window. According to the report, Fulham are trying to tie Bassey down to fresh terms and are ready to improve his current salary significantly. However, the issue is straightforward enough. Their proposal is not yet at the level Manchester United could potentially offer, and that gap is giving this story real momentum. Even so, there is a notable complication in the structure of Fulham’s wage bill. As outlined in the report, “Formal negotiations have already opened with the player’s representatives, although discussions are proving complicated by Fulham’s existing wage structure.” That detail matters. sports.description: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images Luka Dončić admitted he threw his wristband at a fan before getting shoved, a move that may have started a fight. The Lakers star lost his temper after his team blew a 20-point lead to lose 99-96 on Friday night. Blaming the fan for the push ignores the fact that Dončić tossed the item at a person first. That action was the spark, and the player needs to take full responsibility for it. The video from Amazon Prime Video shows the exact moment the trouble began. Dončić tossed his white wristband toward a woman sitting in the first row as he walked toward the tunnel. Reports note that the woman appeared to say something to him before he threw the gear. He then doubled back to grab the wristband, which led to the physical contact. Dončić explained the sequence in his own words after the game. “I just threw my wristband like I do almost every game, and then I heard she or he didn’t want it,” Dončić explained postgame, according to a report. He went on to describe the push that followed his attempt to retrieve the item. “So I went back to grab it, and he just pushed me, and then I gave it to somebody else.” While no one should touch a player, the NBA star created the volatile situation by treating a paying customer like trash. Throwing equipment at fans is never acceptable, regardless of the score. Luka Doncic involved in an incident walking off the court following game at Spurs: pic.twitter.com/920AalPX6O — Underdog NBA (@UnderdogNBA) November 28, 2026 The Collapse That Sparked the Temper The incident happened right after the San Antonio Spurs completed a stunning comeback to win the game. The Lakers held a 20-point lead before the third quarter, but the Spurs outscored them 30-14 in that period. The final score of 99-96 ended the Lakers’ run in the NBA Cup group play. This loss officially eliminated the team from the tournament, leaving them with a 2-2 record. Dončić finished the night with 31 points on 14-of-31 shooting, along with 8 assists and 6 rebounds. His frustration was clear, but his reaction to the fans was the real story. Security Steps In Immediately Lakers forward Jarred Vanderbilt pulled Dončić away from the fan after the shove occurred. Team and arena security moved in right away to separate the parties and calm the scene. The male fan who pushed Dončić was ejected from Frost Bank Center for his actions. Two-way big man Carson Cooper helped hold Vanderbilt back as the situation de-escalated. It remains unclear if the NBA will fine or suspend Dončić for his part in the exchange. The league will review the footage to decide on any punishment for the player. Throwing a wristband at a spectator may be a lapse in judgment that a star player cannot make. Dončić said he heard someone did not want the item, yet he chose to toss it at them anyway. That decision turned a routine postgame walk into a safety incident. sports.title: Shannon Sharpe says one aspect of Joel Embiid’s game has become ‘awful’ now
sports.description: Photo by Andy Lyons/Getty Images The Philadelphia 76ers may be one of the most in-form teams in the NBA right now, but Shannon Sharpe still isn’t overly happy with one area of Joel Embiid’s game. The 76ers most recently took to the court on Friday night, securing a 111-87 win over the Indiana Pacers to go 16-4 for the season. That result means they have a very comfortable lead at the top of the Eastern Conference, with no other side managing more than 12 wins at present. During that victory, Embiid scored 14 points, had 11 rebounds and three assists. But Sharpe is not happy with how the player is performing from three-point range. Shannon Sharpe calls out Joel Embiid’s three-point shooting Speaking on the Nightcap podcast after the 76ers beat the Pacers, he said: “The thing is, they have to keep Embiid, he’s a shell of himself Ocho. “He’s still a guy that can get you, like you said, 20 points. He can get you 10, 11 rebounds. But for whatever reason, he’s struggling from the field. “I mean, he’s just awful from three. He hit one tonight, but I think he’s shooting under 20% from three.” Embiid went 1-3 from three-point range on Friday and when looking at his overall record this season, it is hard to argue with Sharpe’s claim. Since first stepping into the NBA in the 2016/17 season, the Sixers star has a 33.4% three-point field goal average. Up until the current campaign, his worst return on that front came in 2024/25, which he ended with a 29.9% average. But in 15 appearances so far this season, he is managing around half of that total (15.6%). Embiid has already addressed his three-point shooting decline earlier this month, saying: “I think the way I’m jumping, and my hands [placement] are just not what it used to be. sports.description: Great Britain had not reached the final of the Davis Cup since they won the tournament in 2015 [Getty Images] Great Britain were unable to give Leon Smith the perfect send-off as Davis Cup captain as Carlos Alcaraz inspired Spain to a 2-0 victory in the semi-finals. Competing in their first Davis Cup semi-final since 2019, Britain fell short as Arthur Fery was unable to match the dazzling brilliance of Alcaraz, with the seven-time major winner surging to an emphatic 6-2 6-1 win. That was after rising star Rafael Jodar defeated Cameron Norrie 6-2 7-5 in the opening singles match to put Spain in the driving seat in Bologna. The defeat brings the curtain down on Smith's near 17-year tenure as captain, during which he led Britain to Davis Cup success in 2015. Spain captain David Ferrer, who is also stepping down after this year's tournament, will have the chance to guide his nation to their first Davis Cup title since 2019 when they face Italy in Sunday's final. Bronson Reed , whose real name was Jermaine Haley, died on November 27, 2026, at the age of 38 due to “medical complications.” At the WWE Crown Jewel event just weeks before his death, Reed had suffered several broken ribs and a lacerated kidney. Reed and Haley were high school sweethearts in Australia and had been together a total of 24 years. At the time of Reed’s death, they were married. Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Texas football team clinched a spot in the SEC Championship Game after a 16-6 win over Texas A&M. It was hardly the most impressive performance from Arch Manning and co. Manning went just 18-of-34 for 143 yards (his lowest passing total of the season) with a touchdown and an interception, but they were not really in any real danger against the Aggies. After the game, Manning and the team happily celebrated their SEC Championship berth with the marching band in College Station. Arch Manning and Texas celebrating with the band after the victory 😂 pic.twitter.com/6mCxBYlYkO Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) — Orangebloods.com (@orangebloods_) November 28, 2026 A smiling Manning was seen dapping up teammates and staff members, and also took a selfie with a young fan. After a two-game blip against Oklahoma and Florida, Manning and the Longhorns finished the regular season strong as they won their last six games. Manning was a bit of a mixed bag during that span, though, with great performances against Mississippi State and Missouri coupled with some less convincing performances against LSU and A&M. His overall numbers (2,628 yards, 22 touchdowns, 11 interceptions) this season don’t look all that impressive on paper. He was statistically superior last season, particularly as a rusher, where he had 399 yards and 10 touchdowns. Needless to say, nothing short of Manning’s best will likely be needed for Texas to overcome No. 1 Georgia in the SEC title game. The Bulldogs have simply bulldozed past their ranked opposition in recent weeks en route to a four-game winning streak. Their defense in particular has taken it up a notch as they’ve held three of their last four foes to under 10 points. sports.title: Red Sox Should Explore Signing 2020 Cy Young Winner This Offseason
sports.description: Red Sox Should Explore Signing 2020 Cy Young Winner This Offseason originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Contending teams are always looking for pitching, and the Red Sox , despite having one of the best starting rotations in baseball, find themselves in a situation where making a move or two could make sense. The one thing the Red Sox have to be mindful of is not overspending on a starter, which is why taking a chance on a guy with above-average stuff who might not be what he once was could be a wise decision. Something similar to what the Red Sox did with Sonny Gray could make a lot of sense. Last offseason, the idea behind landing Gray was to add a veteran arm with a strong track record at a reasonable price. Shane Bieber is similar, as he's an arm who once had Cy Young-caliber stuff, and the hope is that he can get back to something close to that level. Bieber won a Cy Young Award back in 2020, posting a 1.63 ERA in 12 games during the shortened COVID season. Obviously, there's risk involved. Bieber has dealt with injuries, and it would be unfair to suggest that he's anything like he once was. However, that's exactly why he should be somewhat cheap. With Garrett Crochet, Payton Tolle, and Ranger Suarez, the Red Sox will have one of the best 1-2-3 punches in Major League Baseball next season, if not the best. If they could land a player like Bieber and he can do what he did in 2022 for the Guardians, when he posted a 2.88 ERA, they would undoubtedly have the best four-man rotation in the game. The question for Boston is how much it's willing to spend. There doesn't seem to be an expectation that Bieber will be too expensive, as he only threw 55.2 innings last season and 40.1 the year before. sports.title: Aaron Rodgers gets free agency update after Steelers release that could end his career
sports.description: Aaron Rodgers gets free agency update after Steelers release that could end his career originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Pittsburgh Steelers lost to the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 11, and a few days later, after Aaron Rodgers went on The Pat McAfee Show to stir the pot with Mike McCarthy in particular, the Steelers waived the veteran quarterback. Rodgers hit waivers, but he went unclaimed. Now, he's a free agent and can sign with any team he wants this season. But there's one issue Rodgers now has to deal with: finding a team interested in his services. According to The Ringers' Tom Pelissero , there aren't any teams showing interest in Rodgers right now. If that doesn't change, with this 2026 season being Rodgers' last, his release by the Steelers could be what ends his Hall of Fame NFL career. Aaron Rodgers at risk of finding no new team after release from Steelers "No immediate suitors emerged for Aaron Rodgers after he cleared waivers Thursday," Pelissero reports. "And barring an injury-driven emergency, league sources don't foresee the four-time NFL MVP playing again in what Rodgers has repeatedly said is his final season." Coming into the 2026 NFL season, Rodgers made it known this would be his last year in the NFL. But after just 11 weeks, his season has been cut short, and not due to injury. He was waived by the Steelers following his public bashing of the Steelers' head coach, accusing him of sleeping during meetings and revealing the embarrassing "1, 2, 3, Packers !" breakdown from McCarthy at halftime vs. the Eagles. MORE : One play, two devastating injuries: How Aidan Hutchinson’s Drake Maye sack shakes up AFC, NFC playoff races While there's plenty of drama likely to come from the fallout between Rodgers and the Steelers, for the future Hall of Fame quarterback, what does his future entail? Unfortunately for Rodgers, it doesn't seem there is an interested team willing to call up Rodgers for a chance to start right now. It would have to be an injury to a quarterback on a contending team that has no other option but to turn to Rodgers. It might also take the backup struggling in a major way. A situation akin to what the Minnesota Vikings experienced, with Kyler Murray hurt and Carson Wentz playing horribly, led to a trade for Kirk Cousins. That's the kind of situation that might lead to the ex-Steelers QB finding a new landing spot this season. If he can't land with a new team, there's a real chance that Rodgers' career has ended thanks to his release from the Steelers prior to Week 12, a game in which the Steelers blew out the Denver Broncos 27-5 without Rodgers. sports.title: Tom Pelissero Drops Major Update on Future of Aaron Rodgers
sports.description: Has Aaron Rodgers already played his final NFL game? According to a new report from NFL insider Tom Pelissero, that appears to be a very real possibility following the four-time NFL MVP’s controversial departure from the Pittsburgh Steelers. Rodgers officially became a free agent Thursday after clearing waivers without being claimed . However, despite being available to sign with any team, the veteran quarterback apparently isn’t generating much interest around the league. Nov 22, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers (8) reacts after the game at Lincoln Financial Field. Mandatory Credit: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) NFL Insider Delivers Unfortunate Update on Aaron Rodgers On Saturday morning, Pelissero took to social media to report that no immediate suitors have emerged for Rodgers. Additionally, league sources believe it would likely take an injury to another quarterback for Rodgers to receive another opportunity. “No immediate suitors emerged for Aaron Rodgers after he cleared waivers Thursday,” Pelissero wrote on X . “And barring an injury-driven emergency, league sources don’t foresee the four-time NFL MVP playing again in what Rodgers has repeatedly said is his final season.” The report comes just days after Rodgers publicly unloaded on Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show . The quarterback was also absent from the Steelers’ facility Wednesday before Pittsburgh ultimately decided to release him. An Unceremonious Ending to a Legendary NFL Career? Rodgers’ situation has generated plenty of discussion around the NFL, including criticism from Tom Brady regarding the importance of keeping locker-room matters private. According to Reuters , Rodgers subsequently defended his decision to publicly criticize McCarthy. For Detroit Lions fans who spent nearly two decades watching Rodgers torment their favorite team as a member of the Green Bay Packers, it is difficult to imagine his career ending this way. The four-time MVP and Super Bowl XLV champion will eventually have his place in the Pro Football Hall of Fame, regardless of how his playing career concludes. Rodgers has not officially announced his retirement, and an injury elsewhere in the league could still change his circumstances. However, based on Pelissero’s latest reporting, there is a legitimate possibility that one of the greatest quarterbacks in NFL history has already taken his final snap.

sports.title: Brad Faxon suggests Brooks Koepka actually has a ‘secret sauce’ with his putter just like Ben Crenshaw
sports.description: Photo by Mike Ehrmann/Getty Images Brooks Koepka drafted in Brad Faxon to help him with his putting earlier this year. Koepka really struggled on the greens during the 2026 PGA Tour season, ranking well down in 121st in strokes gained putting. His woeful putting cost him the chance to win on the PGA Tour this year. There is absolutely no doubt about that. However, Brooks Koepka will be confident heading into the 2027 season as he continues to work closely with Brad Faxon . Interestingly, Faxon suggested he would love to help Koepka back in August of this year before the five-time major champion actually reached out to him. Now the 36-year-old will be hoping that Faxon’s influence helps him return to the winners’ circle. Brad Faxon suggests Brooks Koepka actually has a ‘secret sauce’ with his putter Faxon spoke about the work he has been doing with Koepka during The Skins Game on Friday. He responded when asked what his key message to the five-time major champion has been so far, as quoted by Golf Digest . “I think, really, if you ask what we have worked on, it’s, number one, get you back to enjoying putting again,” Faxon said. “That’s an important part that I think is really underrated. I think there’s a lot of great putting instructors out there that know tons about the putting stroke … When you have to read an instruction manual before you go out to play in something that’s meaningful, I think sometimes there’s too much of that that goes on. “And I just wanted him to kind of understand that his instinct was … you don’t get to the point Brooks Koepka has without having great instinct, athleticism and ability. “ Brooks Koepka’s ‘unique’ putting stroke Brad Faxon explained how Koepka’s unique putting stroke is something that actually gave him an edge over his rivals. “Brooks is unique,” Faxon explained. “His stroke … he never really aimed the ball right on the face directly. It was a little towards the toe. He had a little bit of a loop in his transition, a lot like Ben Crenshaw; Greg Norman even had that. And I’ve always told him that was what I thought was his secret sauce to how he became a great putter. “And I asked him if he would be willing to go back away from the mallet that he had been using for the last year or two and go back to his gamer. That’s the putter that he won his majors with, and I think he’s familiar with.” Ben Crenshaw is widely regarded as one of the best putters in the history of the game. So, if a ‘loopy’ putting stroke was good enough for him, it should be more than good enough for Koepka. If Koepka is able to take more of a natural approach to his putting, he will have a good chance of winning again. The American has to stop over-analyzing his putting stroke and remember what actually made him such a successful golfer in the first place.

The free agent catching market is limited so it gives San Diego an opportunity to work a deal for other major league talent or minor league talent that will improve the farm system. San Diego has been quiet to this point on the free agent market and with minimal time remaining before the expected lockout on Dec. 1, the Padres need to do something to get better for the 2027 season — should there be a 2027 season. technology.title: Quantum: 'Five years, that's all we got…'
technology.description: SC26 in Chicago had the usual quantum booths, discussions, and hallway optimism. A lot of people were talking about integration with classical HPC and Slurm scheduling for quantum processors, co-design platforms, and GPU-accelerated error correction tools. That part is real and useful. What was harder to find was any result that changed the basic math on when quantum systems will actually do something a supercomputer can't already handle better. I had a long conversation in St. Louis (SC25) with a contact who works deep in quantum and has spent decades in HPC. He's not a skeptic for sport, although that can be fun, sure. Over a grifted free dinner in Chicago (the best kind), his take this year remains the same: the hype keeps outrunning the error rates. Quantum computers generate too many errors to give usable answers on anything interesting. Fixing that is the whole game. And that's a five-year game, minimum. Much like the Bowie anthem in the title. Qubits by the numbers There are two kinds of qubits. Physical qubits are the actual hardware: ions, superconducting circuits, and atoms in a trap. Logical qubits are the ones that do the computation. Each logical qubit is built out of many physical ones so the system can detect and correct errors while it runs. With the traditional surface-code approach, one logical qubit often needs somewhere between 500 and 2,000 physical qubits backing it up, depending on the hardware and the code. One logical qubit by itself is useless. Estimates for basic scientific modeling and small-scale simulation sit in the 100-to-500 logical-qubit range. Take the midpoint of 300. At the low end of the overhead that is 150,000 physical qubits. At the high end it is several million. That is only for early science. Commercial work like molecular mapping for pharma, large optimization problems, complex financial models, pushes into the thousands of logical qubits. National-security and encryption-related work sits even higher. Those numbers have not magically shrunk. A system that can map a modestly sized drug molecule, or run a materials simulation that is still too slow on classical machines, is the kind of workload people actually mean when they talk about useful quantum advantage. Until the logical-qubit counts get there with error rates low enough to finish the job, those problems stay on the machines we already know how to build. Ok, so let's just scale it up This is the world of HPC, we know how to scale stuff, right? Yes, but this isn't a matter of adding a few more racks. Scaling to an additional few hundred thousand physical qubits is not a rack or two or ten. It's probably a dedicated building with its own cryogenics, control electronics, and power draw that is still measured in megawatts even before you get useful logical capacity.
